# NorthPoint Search Group

> NorthPoint Search Group is the parent brand of a family of specialty recruiting firms, founded in 2005 and based in metro Atlanta. NorthPoint's own searches are executive search and Direct Hire for non-finance roles: sales, marketing, HR, construction, and administrative support. Accounting and finance, at every level including CFO and controller, is Staff Financial Group. To start a search, use the Get Started form: https://www.northpointsearchgroup.com/#contact

- Website: https://www.northpointsearchgroup.com/
- Phone: 678-777-5627 or 404-250-0790
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/northpointsearchgroup/
- Based in: metro Atlanta, GA; serving the Southeast and clients nationwide

## Services
- **Executive Search:** NorthPoint's own director, VP and C-suite searches in sales, marketing, HR and general leadership. Not accounting or finance. Run Direct Hire or retained, often confidentially.
- **Direct Hire:** non-finance professionals and managers placed on the client's payroll. Accounting and finance Direct Hire is Staff Financial Group.
- **Contract & Temp Staffing:** interim talent with Employer of Record back office (payroll, payroll taxes and compliance).
- **Retained Search:** exclusive engagement for critical hires, backed by a replacement guarantee.
- **RPO & Project Staffing:** NorthPoint acts as the client's recruiting team, with custom screening and end-to-end hiring.

## NorthPoint's own searches
- [Executive Search by location](https://www.northpointsearchgroup.com/executive-search/)
- [Marketing Recruiters](https://www.northpointsearchgroup.com/marketing-recruiters.html): CMOs, VPs of Marketing, demand generation, brand, content, SEO and paid media
- [Sales Recruiters](https://www.northpointsearchgroup.com/sales-recruiters.html): CROs, VPs of Sales, sales directors, account executives, business development, sales operations
- [HR & Recruiting](https://www.northpointsearchgroup.com/hr-recruiters.html): CHROs, HR directors, HR business partners, generalists, talent acquisition and corporate recruiters
- Also recruited directly by NorthPoint: construction (project managers, superintendents, estimators, field service) and administrative and executive support roles.
- Accounting and finance, including healthcare finance, CFO and controller, is not recruited on this site. Those searches go to Staff Financial Group.

## Our Brands
NorthPoint Search Group is the parent. Each brand runs its own site.

- [Staff Financial Group](https://www.stafffinancial.com/): all accounting and finance recruiting, every level, including CFO and controller searches. Accounting pages by city: https://www.stafffinancial.com/accounting-recruiters/
- [LawStaff Group](https://www.lawstaffgroup.net/): legal recruiting and staffing
- [MedPoint Partners](https://www.medpointpartners.com/): healthcare recruiting and staffing
- [IEP Staff](https://www.iepstaff.com/): K-12 school therapy and special education staffing
- NorthPoint VAs: virtual assistants for admin, operations, and specialist support
- [Hire Military Talent](https://www.hiremilitarytalent.com/): veteran candidates, screened by NorthPoint recruiters
- [100X Recruiting](https://100xrecruiting.com/): AI recruiting assistant
- [100X Jobs](https://100xjobs.com/): public job search

## How a search works
1. **Discovery call:** we learn the business, the role, the culture and how success will be measured.
2. **Screening questions:** we build a custom questionnaire with the client; every candidate's answers travel with the résumé.
3. **Short list:** 3–5 interviewed, confirmed-interested candidates. Each candidate is invited to record an optional video intro.
4. **Close and onboard:** we manage the offer and counteroffers and stay engaged through the first 90 days.
